selection_rules.LAB033A: candidate must EV>0, PF>1, R/DD >=90% of baseline in both samples, and >=10% forward trade-count gain; among eligible choose most robust R/DD ratio, then smallest parameter move
selection_rules.LAB033B: 30m must pass same R/DD guards and add >=5% forward trades
selection_rules.LAB034B: dynamic ATR selected only if guards pass and minimum historical/forward R/DD ratio vs baseline is >=1.0
selection_rules.LAB035: no automatic promotion; report all three because cancellation may remove right-tail reversals
